---
title: "`r params$title`"
report-class: scenario
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
    md_extensions: "-native_divs-native_spans"
  pdf_document:
    latex_engine: xelatex
  word_document: default
params:
  title:        "Scenario report"
  scen_name:    ""
  scen_desc:    ""
  image_file:   NULL
  status_df:    NULL
  runs_df:      NULL
  run_info_df:  NULL
  size_df:      NULL
  verify_df:    NULL
  gen_plot:     NULL
  gen_day_plot: NULL
  cap_plot:     NULL
  newcap_plot:  NULL
  emis_df:      NULL
  cost_df:      NULL
  costs_plot:   NULL
  variants_df:  NULL
  levcost_df:   NULL
header-includes:
  - \usepackage{booktabs}
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)

# Shared helpers live in the package (see ?energyRt::report_helpers).
fmt <- energyRt::report_setup()
tbl <- function(df, caption = NULL, digits = 4L)
  energyRt::report_tbl(df, caption, digits, output = fmt)
emit_img <- function(path, frac = 1)
  energyRt::report_img(path, frac, output = fmt)
```

```{r css, results='asis'}
energyRt::report_css(fmt)
```

```{r logo, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(params$image_file)) emit_img(params$image_file, 0.25)
```

`r if (isTRUE(nzchar(params$scen_desc))) params$scen_desc`

## Overview

```{r status, results='asis'}
tbl(params$status_df)
```

```{r size, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$size_df)}
tbl(params$size_df, caption = "Problem size")
```

```{r verify, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$verify_df)}
tbl(params$verify_df, caption = "Solution checks (verify_solution)")
```

```{r runs-header, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$runs_df) && nrow(params$runs_df) > 0}
cat("## Runs\n")
```

```{r runs, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$runs_df) && nrow(params$runs_df) > 0}
tbl(params$runs_df)
```

```{r run-info, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$run_info_df)}
tbl(params$run_info_df, caption = "Reported run")
```

```{r gen, fig.width=8, fig.height=4.5, eval=!is.null(params$gen_plot)}
params$gen_plot
```

```{r cap, fig.width=8, fig.height=4.5, eval=!is.null(params$cap_plot)}
params$cap_plot
```

```{r newcap, fig.width=8, fig.height=4.5, eval=!is.null(params$newcap_plot)}
params$newcap_plot
```

```{r costs-plot, fig.width=7, fig.height=4, eval=!is.null(params$costs_plot)}
params$costs_plot
```

```{r costs, results='asis'}
tbl(params$cost_df)
```


```{r emis, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$emis_df)}
tbl(params$emis_df)
```

```{r variants-header, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$variants_df)}
cat("## Variants\n")
```

```{r variants, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$variants_df)}

```
